additional_estimates.comparison: Baseline serum vitamin B12; contrast not reported in the abstract
additional_estimates.effect_excerpt: Their associations with PCa and BC risk categories were evaluated using Cox proportional hazards regression. During mean follow-up of 13 years, 703 men developed PCa. There was an inverse association between folate > 32 nmol/L and high-risk PCa [hazard ratio (HR) 0.12, 95% confidence interval (CI) 0.02-0.90], and a positive association between folate < 5 nmol/L and metastatic PCa (HR 5.25, 95% CI 1.29-21.41), compared with folate 5-32 nmol/L. No associations with vitamin B12 were found.
